"Why there\'s a guardian — it\'s a race"

"Minima signs with one-time keys. Signing twice with the same one leaks it, and that address is then exposed forever.

Your money can never be stolen AT collection: the chain only lets a collected coin go to the payout address you chose when locking. The risk is what happens after it lands.

And you don't control when it lands. Collecting a matured stake needs NO signature, so anyone can do it — including someone holding a leaked key, who has every reason to collect your stake onto the address they can forge for, then take it.

So the guardian's job is to be the one who collects, with the sweep already moving:

• Clean payout → collected normally, straight to your node.
• Reused payout → collected AND swept onward in the same pass, no waiting for a confirmation, then checked that it arrived.

That is why it needs a destination before it will run at all: a guardian with nowhere to sweep to can't win the race, it can only watch."

"Safe collection requires a complete audit. A result stays fresh for 30 minutes if minimaWallet’s public-key snapshot is unchanged. After that, the app must re-check the node and minimaWallet key sets and counters; an unchanged result can be used for up to 24 hours. Changed or unavailable keys pause safe collection. Local checks cannot detect new reuse by another copy of your seed; fresh online audits are still needed."

"In order of likelihood:
① The embedded node is not running.
② The guardian isn't started.
③ At-risk stake: rescue isn't set up, or your vault is locked.
④ Your safe destination was flagged REUSED — set a fresh one.
⑤ Auto-collect is off — use Collect on the stake itself.

Nothing is lost by waiting: matured coins stay locked to your payout address until collected."

"KISS VM QUICK REFERENCE
(full docs: https://docs.minima.global)

VARIABLES
 LET myvar = 5
 LET hpk = PREVSTATE(0)
 NO underscores in names — they silently fail on-chain!

CONTROL FLOW
 IF cond THEN ... ELSEIF cond THEN ... ELSE ... ENDIF
 WHILE cond DO ... ENDWHILE
 ASSERT expression (fails script if false)
 RETURN TRUE|FALSE (must return a boolean)

STATE
 STATE(port) read from the SPENDING transaction
 PREVSTATE(port) read from the INPUT COIN (set at creation)
 SAMESTATE(start end) assert STATE==PREVSTATE over a port range

SIGNATURES
 SIGNEDBY(pubkey) tx signed by this key
 MULTISIG(n pk1 pk2 ...) n-of-m signature check

TXN VERIFICATION
 VERIFYOUT(idx address amount tokenid keepstate)
 keepstate TRUE = phase transition (output keeps state, storestate:true)
 keepstate FALSE = final payout (output must NOT store state)
 VERIFYIN(idx address amount tokenid)
 GETOUTADDR/GETOUTAMT/GETOUTTOK/GETOUTKEEPSTATE(idx)
 GETINADDR/GETINAMT/GETINTOK/GETINID(idx)
 SUMINPUTS(tokenid) SUMOUTPUTS(tokenid)

CRYPTO
 SHA3(data) SHA2(data) 32-byte hash
 CONCAT(a b) 0xAA+0xBB -> 0xAABB
 SUBSET(start len data) slice hex bytes
 NUMBER(hex) small hex -> number (max ~4 bytes!)
 Random pattern: LET r = NUMBER(SUBSET(0 4 SHA3(CONCAT(s1 s2)))) % range

GLOBALS
 @COINAGE blocks since coin created — USE THIS for timeouts
 @BLKNUM current block — BROKEN on synced nodes, avoid
 @INPUT @AMOUNT @ADDRESS @TOKENID @COINID
 @TOTIN @TOTOUT @SCRIPT @FLOATING @CREATED @BLOCK

OPERATORS
 Compare: EQ NEQ GT GTE LT LTE
 Boolean: AND OR XOR NAND NOR NXOR NOT (TRUE/FALSE only, NOT bitwise)
 Math: + - * / % (MiniNumber arbitrary precision)

HARD LIMITS (proven on-chain)
 ~1200 chars max script size — silently fails beyond
 1024 instructions per execution · 64 stack depth · 256 state ports
 NUMBER() on a full 32-byte hash overflows — SUBSET(0 4 ...) first

PROVEN RULES
 - Phase transitions: VERIFYOUT(... TRUE) + output storestate:true
 - Final payouts: VERIFYOUT(... FALSE) + output storestate:false
 - Store timeout in state, check @COINAGE GT timeout
 - Set every state port your script reads — unset ports can crash
 - Test offline with Run (runscript) before deploying real funds

Export archive data to a MySQL server.

The MySQL db can be used to perform a chain re-sync to put users on the correct chain,

or a seed re-sync to restore access to lost funds, using the seed phrase.

Can query an address for its history of spent and unspent coins.

Additionally export the MySQL db to a gzip file for resyncing with 'reset' or 'archive' command.

You can use setlogin to auto set the login details

database:
 name of the MySQL db being used to store the archive db data.

user:

logs:
 Show detailed logs - default true.

 autobackup : Automatically save archive data to MySQL DB. Use with enable. Also stores all TxPoW the node sees.

 resync : Perform a chain or seed re-sync from the specified MySQL db.
 Will shutdown the node so you must restart it once complete.
